title: dryopteris sandwicensis
intro: Dryopteris sandwicensis, commonly known as Ma'o hau hele or Yellow Haw, is a species of fern endemic to the Hawaiian Islands. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including the treatment of various health issues. The health benefits of Dryopteris sandwicensis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-bacterial activities, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory effects.
